title: Round 14: net2 learned from the reward on net1 v6, alone as often as evaluated
description: net1 v6 replaces v5 (exp-net1v6-inrange-152), and the fixed rule on v6 keeps u = 0.25 (exp-rule-net1v6-val-153: best on all three campaign seeds, +0.133 to +0.138 over BBRv3, u 0.125 next at +0.127 to +0.130). Round 13 showed PPO is not biased towards pushing: trained always alone, it lowered u and beat the rule there. Round 12 showed the mixture alone 0.4, compete 0.4 removes round 10's losses when alone (its cells finished so far stay within about +0.02 of the rule, trading small gains between competition and the flow alone across checkpoints). Round 14 runs round 12's learner and mixture on net1 v6, from v6's rule: recurrent PPO, team reward among copies, privileged critic with flow counts, sigma 0.2 held 200 ms, 30 s episodes, diverse competition, alone 0.4, compete 0.4, 120 iterations; tau 1 s and 5 s (round 13's tau 5 s learned best when alone), seeds 1 to 3. Each iteration's policy is kept, so a checkpoint can be chosen on validation before the gate. Validation links only.
prepare: N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r14-tau$TAU-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson tau "$TAU" --argjson seed "$SEED" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = $tau | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .alone = 0.4 | .compete = 0.4 | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r14-tau$TAU-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
